metadata.scenario: A new customer queries a billing discrepancy, noticing an unexpected charge on their invoice. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute. Customer type: new_customer.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Helen Johnson. I'm a client and I have a question about my last invoice. Hi Helen, it’s great to hear from you. What seems to be the issue with your invoice? I noticed an unexpected charge for physical therapy. I was only supposed to be billed for my last session. I understand your concern. Let me pull up your account and invoice details. One moment, please. Sure, take your time. I just want to make sure I’m not being overcharged, especially after all the therapy I've been through. I completely understand, Helen. I’m checking your records now. It looks like there was an error in our billing system. You were charged for an additional session that wasn’t scheduled. I’m sorry about that. Oh, I see. So, what happens now? Will that charge be removed? Yes, I’ll initiate a correction right away. It should be removed from your account within 48 hours. That’s a relief. Thank you for taking care of that. Of course! Is there anything else on your mind while I have you on the line? Actually, yes. I was wondering if there are any options for ongoing therapy sessions. I feel I could still use some help. Absolutely! We offer ongoing physical therapy packages. Would you like me to send you more information on those? Yes, that would be great! I’d like to see what my options are. Perfect, I’ll send you an email with the details and pricing. Can I confirm your email address is helen.johnson@email.com? Yes, that’s correct. Great! So just to recap, I’ll remove the extra charge and send you the therapy options. Thank you, Margaret. I really appreciate your help with this! My pleasure, Helen! If you have any more questions, feel free to reach out. I will, thanks again! Have a great day! You too, Helen! Take care! Goodbye! Goodbye!
